title.en: Switch between list and grid view

summary.zh-TW: 按右上角的按鈕在清單和格狀之間切換：每個項目、裡面的方塊和文字，都從原本的位置移動、縮放到新的位置，一眼就看得出誰去了哪裡。版面只靠切換 CSS class，動畫全部交給 Flip。
summary.en: Toggle between list and grid with the buttons at the top right: every item, its thumbnail and its text move and scale from where they were to where they go, so you can see what went where. The layout is just a CSS class; Flip handles all the motion.

text.zh-TW: ① 先記下所有東西現在的位置和大小，不只外層的項目，也包括裡面的方塊和文字。
text.en: ① Record where everything is now — not just the items but their thumbnails and text too.

text.zh-TW: ② 直接切換 CSS class，版面瞬間變成另一種。清單和格狀的樣子完全寫在 CSS，設計師改版面不用動 JS。
text.en: ② Toggle the CSS class and the layout switches instantly. Both layouts live entirely in CSS, so designers can restyle without touching JS.

text.zh-TW: 項目裡面的方塊和文字，位置會跟著外層一起變。加上 nested，Flip 才會把「外層的移動」扣掉，裡面的東西不會飄移錯位。
text.en: The thumbnail and text move along with their item. nested tells Flip to account for the parent’s movement so the children don’t drift.

text.zh-TW: 方塊從 48px 變成整張卡片寬，用縮放（scale）過去而不是改寬高，動畫比較順；Flip 會在結束時換回真正的尺寸。
text.en: The thumbnail grows from 48px to card width by scaling rather than resizing, which is smoother; Flip restores the real size at the end.
